mapper.select: SELECT i.TOTAL_SALARY, i.HOMELESS_HEAD_YN, i.HOUSING_SAVING, i.PENSION_SAVING, i.IRP_SAVING FROM PREDICTION_INPUT i JOIN PREDICTION p ON p.PREDICTION_ID = i.PREDICTION_ID WHERE p.PREDICTION_ID = #{predictionId} AND p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT r.CONTENT FROM RECOMMENDATION r JOIN PREDICTION p ON p.PREDICTION_ID = r.PREDICTION_ID WHERE r.PREDICTION_ID = #{predictionId} AND p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.REC_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECOMMENDATION (REC_ID, PREDICTION_ID, TYPE_ID, CONTENT, SAVING_AMOUNT, LLM_MODEL) SELECT SEQ_RECOMMENDATION.NEXTVAL, p.PREDICTION_ID, NULL, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, NULL, #{llmModel} FROM PREDICTION p WHERE p.PREDICTION_ID = #{predictionId} AND p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
